fact: Law 25-11 of 24 July 2025, published in the Journal Officiel that day, adds article 45 bis 13 to Law 18-07, under which the competent authority assesses the adequate level of protection in a foreign State or international organisation before data are transferred there, for transfers for criminal-justice purposes, and allows transfer on insufficient safeguards only in listed cases (vital interests, public security threat, individual criminal cases); the document gives as_of as its publication date and states no separate entry-into-force date.
